eips.title: Fork-choice enforced Inclusion Lists (FOCIL)
eips.summary: Entire call focused on FOCIL spec PRs, IL deadlines, equivocation proofs, bid design, and PQ readiness.

moments.context: Jihoon noted that EIP-7805 does not support blob transactions, motivating a spec change from must-not to should-not for blob transaction inclusion in ILs.
Discussion of IL broadcast timing, the IL deadline, and preventing split views before and after block reveal, all core FOCIL design questions.
Extended discussion on whether to add IL equivocation proofs in the envelope or bid to help attesters converge on the same IL view.
Discussion of replacing IL bitlists with IL roots in bids to make builders more accountable for which ILs they considered.
Agreement to schedule a dedicated FOCIL breakout next week to discuss PQ FOCIL readiness before the next ACDC.

eips.title: In-mempool signature and proof aggregation
eips.summary: Named as one of the post-quantum building blocks the call had been reasoning from, while arguing PQ FOCIL needs scoping first.

moments.context: soispoke observed the call had spent its time on XMSS signatures and EIP-8288, and argued that what PQ FOCIL even looks like needs settling before sizing those signatures.
